description: Grouped bar chart for two series (e.g. points per quarter for two teams), values on the bars, one bar can be highlighted.

fields.title: Chart title. *word* = accent color
fields.labels: Category labels separated by ; e.g. Q1;Q2;Q3;Q4
fields.b_values: Second series values separated by ; (set it empty for a single series: the legend hides)
fields.highlight: Bar to highlight, series + position: a2 = first series, second category. Others are dimmed.
fields.line: Optional reference line across the chart at this value, e.g. a capacity or a limit
fields.line_label: Text on the reference line (default: the value)
